lanes: 6-lane main carriageway, access-controlled, with service roads on both sides

timeline.event: Construction begins on upgrading the old Bengaluru–Mysuru road
Inaugurated by the Prime Minister on 12 March 2023

history: The road between Bengaluru and Mysuru was once a crowded state highway that took about three hours to drive, because it ran straight through the main street of every town on the way. It was rebuilt as a wide, access-controlled expressway on National Highway 275 under the Bharatmala programme and opened in March 2023. The design keeps a six-lane main carriageway for through traffic and adds two-lane service roads on each side for tractors, two-wheelers and local trips, so the two kinds of traffic never mix. New bypasses now carry the expressway around Bidadi, Ramanagara, Channapatna, Maddur, Mandya and Srirangapatna, and an 8 km elevated section lifts the road clear of the most built-up stretch. The result cut the drive to roughly 75–90 minutes, though the sudden jump in speeds also brought a rash of crashes in the first year and forced NHAI to add extra signs, speed cameras and safety barriers.
facts: Cut the Bengaluru–Mysuru drive from about 3 hours to roughly 75–90 minutes.
Part of NH 275, which continues beyond Mysuru towards Kodagu and coastal Karnataka.
Built with bypasses around six towns along the old road.
The main carriageway has 6 lanes, with separate service roads for local traffic.
Includes an elevated corridor about 8 km long.
Has 9 major bridges, 42 minor bridges, 64 underpasses and 11 overpasses.
Two-wheelers, auto-rickshaws and tractors must use the service roads, not the main lanes.
Built under the Bharatmala Pariyojana highway programme.
significance: This is Karnataka's busiest tourist and commuter corridor — Mysuru Palace, Srirangapatna, Kodagu and Bandipur all sit at the far end of it, and lakhs of Bengaluru families drive it on weekends. It also carries the first leg of the Bengaluru–Mangaluru economic corridor, so factory goods heading for the west coast ports start their journey here. For the towns in between, the bypasses gave back their own main streets.

engineering.name: Elevated corridor
engineering.note: about 8 km of the expressway is raised on pillars so through traffic flies over the busiest built-up stretch

travelNotes: Plan on 75–90 minutes, and note the two toll plazas near Bidadi and on the Mysuru side. Saturday mornings out of Bengaluru and Sunday evenings coming back are the busy times, and long weekends can be slow at the toll gates. The old roadside food stops — Bidadi thatte idli, Maddur vada, Mandya sugarcane juice — are now on the service roads or in the bypassed towns, so you have to take an exit for them. Two-wheelers and slow vehicles are not allowed on the main lanes, and the wide open carriageway tempts people into very high speeds, so watch for sudden slow traffic near the interchanges.
futureUpgrades: The next stretch of NH 275, from Mysuru toward Kushalnagar in Kodagu, has been approved for four-laning.
NHAI is adding more safety works — extra signs, speed cameras, crash barriers and pedestrian crossings — after the crashes in the first year.
